name: SPACEGODZILLA
about: The C example SPACEGODZILLA rebuilt in blocks: the powerlines light the locks, harder each time; three crystals planted at the Big loop start a 3-ball multiball whose towers fall to jackpots for a super worth their sum; the three multiballs in turn are CRYSTAL TOWERS, M.O.G.U.E.R.A. and SPACE BEAST.
lost: No points while the mode is not running: the C pays 250,000 a crystal times its number (250,000, 500,000, 750,000) as it is planted; the blocks' Score only scores while the mode runs.

A lit lock does not blink the Big loop purple: the blocks light inserts only while the mode runs, and a mode lit at a shot starts on it, so only the full set (three crystals, waiting for the game's mode to end) blinks there; the notes say LOCK IS LIT and SHOOT THE BIG LOOP.

No badge for the super's 20 s window: the badge counts the mode's own clock, and this multiball has none, so the window shows as the line SUPER JACKPOT: SHOOT THE BIG LOOP and the Big loop blinking white fast (the C blinks it faster as the window runs out).
The super's added ball is asked as a multiball of one more ball than are in play (the blocks have no add-a-ball block), with its 10 s ball save.

Another mode of ours running does not stop the powerlines lighting locks or the Big loop planting crystals (the blocks cannot tell one of our other modes runs; the C waits for it). A multiball still stops them.
The ending's line puts the jackpots last (1 SUPER  -  JACKPOTS 7) where the C said 7 JACKPOTS  -  1 SUPER, says JACKPOTS for one too, and past 3 supers says only the jackpots.
The ending stays up 3 s, the runtime's: the C kept it 10 s.
No light show of its own at the start and the end where the game has none (the C falls back on its own when the game's Strobe storm or Blue fade will not play): the blocks play the game's.
A tilt or the game moving on ends it as any blocks mode ends (the C also ends at once without its total).

else.sub: ONE MORE POWERLINE LIGHTS A LOCK

then.text: SUPER JACKPOT: SHOOT THE BIG LOOP

intro.what: At 0:36:06 SpaceGodzilla descends through pillars of light with blue lightning onto Birth Island, lands, and crystals erupt around him in a white burst (one shot).

loop.what: At 1:16:27 Godzilla stands among glowing crystal towers in night Fukuoka as sparks fountain from their tips, then a wide shot of the whole blue crystal field glowing over the city (run of two shots, cut at 1:16:31.7).

jackpot.what: At 1:24:51 Land M.O.G.U.E.R.A. fires blue beams into a crystal tower and it bursts in pink fire and sparks (run of quick shots, same angle).

tower.what: At 1:19:23 Godzilla's blue ray sweeps across the night crystal field and the crystal towers explode in white and pink sparks and fire (one shot).

super.what: At 1:36:58 Godzilla fires his red burning spiral ray in close up and it slams into SpaceGodzilla in fire and white sparks (run of shots: cut at 1:37:00.8, then flash cuts during the hit).

won.what: At 1:37:21 SpaceGodzilla explodes in a huge pink and orange fireball over the city while Godzilla stands in silhouette (one shot).

lost.what: At 0:40:14 after SpaceGodzilla's corona beam hits him on Birth Island, Godzilla topples backwards into the smoke and lies on the ground (run of three shots, cuts at 0:40:16.8 and 0:40:17.9).

music.what: Main title march under the opening credits at 0:01:29, the theme that returns in the Birth Island battle with SpaceGodzilla at 0:38:43; orchestral, no dialogue.

lit.what: At 0:37:07.75 a glassy crackling crystal shimmer as crystal spires rise around Little Godzilla, clean start and stop.

lock.what: At 0:36:50.55 SpaceGodzilla shrieks in close up on Birth Island.

jackpot.what: At 1:27:27.35 a crackling energy blast with a shower of sparks as a lightning burst strikes Godzilla among the crystals.

tower.what: At 1:12:24.85 a big crash with debris and sparks as M.O.G.U.E.R.A. slams into the ground, decaying to quiet.

super.what: At 1:24:29.88 a sharp burst and a roar over a close shot of SpaceGodzilla's glowing shoulder crystals.

add.what: At 1:30:06.85 M.O.G.U.E.R.A. launches a missile from its side, a rocket blast and whoosh.

won.what: At 1:38:47.93 Godzilla gives his victory roar in close up after SpaceGodzilla is destroyed.

lost.what: At 1:15:24.27 Godzilla roars in pain as SpaceGodzilla's blue lightning strikes him.
